info.name: CyberSource Merged Spec bankAccountValidation TransactionBatches API
Get a List of Batch Files

params.name: startTime
params.description:
Valid report Start Time in **ISO 8601 format**
Please refer the following link to know more about ISO 8601 format.[Rfc Date Format](https://xml2rfc.tools.ietf.org/public/rfc/html/rfc3339.html#anchor14)

 **Example date format:**
  - yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZZ

params.name: endTime
params.description:
Valid report End Time in **ISO 8601 format**
Please refer the following link to know more about ISO 8601 format.[Rfc Date Format](https://xml2rfc.tools.ietf.org/public/rfc/html/rfc3339.html#anchor14)

 **Example date format:**
  - yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZZ

items.docs: Provide the date and time search range to get a list of Batch Files ready for settlement

params.name: id
params.description: The batch id assigned for the template.

items.docs: This API provides details like upload date, completion date, transaction count and accepted and rejected transaction count of the individual batch file using the batch id

info.name: Get Transaction Details for a given Batch Id

params.name: id
params.description: The batch id assigned for the template.

params.name: uploadDate
params.description:
Date in which the original batch file was uploaded. Date must be in ISO-8601 format.
Please refer the following link to know more about ISO 8601 format.[Rfc Date Format](https://xml2rfc.tools.ietf.org/public/rfc/html/rfc3339.html#anchor14)
**Example date format:**
 - yyyy-MM-dd

params.name: status
params.description:
Allows you to filter by rejected response.

Valid values:
- Rejected

items.docs: Provides real-time detailed status information about the transactions that you previously uploaded in the Business Center or processed with the Offline Transaction File Submission service.
This endpoint enables the upload of a batch file containing transactions for processing.
